symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of cyclic axes, a count of the axes of the box.
symbols.quote: Write $r$ for the number of cyclic axes, not the digit count of the earlier page.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: An index of one cyclic axis, running from 1 to r.
symbols.quote: Write $a$ for an axis index, $1 \le a \le r$, and $t_a$ for the number of positions along axis $a$; the lengths $t_1,\dots,t_r$ are pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions along axis a, a count.
symbols.quote: Write $a$ for an axis index, $1 \le a \le r$, and $t_a$ for the number of positions along axis $a$; the lengths $t_1,\dots,t_r$ are pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: total positions
symbols.meaning: The total number of cyclic positions, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Put $T = t_1 t_2 \cdots t_r$, the total number of positions.

symbols.name: cyclic position
symbols.meaning: A cyclic position with 0 <= p < T on this page, not the coefficient index of the radix-digit page.
symbols.quote: On this page $p$ and $q$ are cyclic positions, not the coefficient index of the radix-digit page, with $0 \le p, q < T$; and $w$ is an output position, not the digit width there.

symbols.name: cyclic position
symbols.meaning: A second cyclic position with 0 <= q < T on this page, not the coefficient index of the radix-digit page.
symbols.quote: On this page $p$ and $q$ are cyclic positions, not the coefficient index of the radix-digit page, with $0 \le p, q < T$; and $w$ is an output position, not the digit width there.

symbols.name: output position
symbols.meaning: An output position with 0 <= w < T on this page, not the digit width of the radix-digit page.
symbols.quote: On this page $p$ and $q$ are cyclic positions, not the coefficient index of the radix-digit page, with $0 \le p, q < T$; and $w$ is an output position, not the digit width there.

symbols.name: residue map
symbols.meaning: The map sending a position to the tuple of its residues modulo the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: The map $\phi$ sends a position $p$ to the tuple of its residues:

relations.predicate: is applied to the coefficients of
relations.quote: The map is applied to the coefficients of [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md).
